verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows Google's Infrastructure Manager service is built around declaratively defining infrastructure 'using Terraform' and offering preview deployments, implying Terraform integration, but there is no explicit mention of the terraform-provider-google itself, its release cadence, or breadth of resource coverage across core GCP services.  missing for 10: explicit confirmation of a vendor-maintained Terraform/OpenTofu provider, its release frequency, and coverage of core services.
